exercises.q: What does о- add in охвати́ть (“to embrace”)?
options: turning into something, giving it particular properties
spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists охвати́ть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).
**охватил** — охвати́ть (perfective): to embrace; to include, to take in. Wiktionary: о- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **охватила** — охвати́ть (perfective): to embrace; to include, to take in. Wiktionary: о- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does о- add in обхвати́ть (“to clasp”)?
options: spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists обхвати́ть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).
**обхватил** — обхвати́ть (perfective): to clasp; to embrace, to enfold; to grapple; to encompass. Wiktionary: об- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **обхватил** — обхвати́ть (perfective): to clasp; to embrace, to enfold; to grapple; to encompass. Wiktionary: об- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does о- add in окле́ить (“to cover by gluing (e.g. a wall with wallpaper)”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists окле́ить under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in усы́пать (“to strew (with), to bestrew (with)”)?
options: keeping in the state the base verb names
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists усы́пать under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in уста́вить (“to set (with), to cover (with)”)?
options: making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists уста́вить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пропита́ть (“to feed, to nourish”)?
options: an action spreading over the whole object
completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
an action lasting for a certain stretch of time
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists пропита́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cover by gluing (e.g. a wall with wallpaper)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: охвати́ть — to embrace; обхвати́ть — to clasp; окле́ить — to cover by gluing (e.g. a wall with wallpaper); усы́пать — to strew (with), to bestrew (with).
